newsitem.title: USA: Calif. Sacramento municipal utility to buy 100 MW.
newsitem.headline: Calif. Sacramento municipal utility to buy 100 MW.

text.p: Sacramento Municipal Utility District (SMUD) said Friday it will purchase up to 100 megawatts (MW) firm power during heavy load hours in the first quarter of next year.
Bids from suppliers, for blocks of 50 MW each, are due by December 3.
The power is for delivery at the California-Oregon border, or in California at Midway, Rancho Seco or Elverta.
SMUD also plans to purchase power for next summer, but has not yet decided on the volume, Steve Sorey, at SMUD's power contract department said.
